title: ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement Register
description: Extension schema for the vwp-accounting-asc820 extension: the fair value measurement register at facts/fair-value-measurements.json. Every measurement's pricing sources must resolve to evidence IDs, and every level 3 measurement must link a judgment (hierarchy leveling and unobservable inputs are professional judgment, not arithmetic) — enforced by the extension validators.

level.description: Fair value hierarchy level. Level classification is a professional judgment; level3 measurements must carry a judgmentRef.

pricingSourceEvidence.description: Evidence IDs for the pricing sources supporting this measurement.

unobservableInputs.description: Significant unobservable inputs (expected for level3 measurements).

judgmentRef.description: Judgment ID covering level classification and unobservable inputs. Required by validators for level3.
